response.rationale: R1 is preferred due to the smooth surface of the ring-shaped opacities without deposits or pigmentation, which is consistent with primary lipoidal degeneration of the cornea. R3 is a close runner-up, but the presence of bandlike structures on confocal microscopy, while suggestive of corneal amyloidosis, is not as specific as the findings supporting R1.

rejected.why: While posterior crocodile shagreen is a distinctive feature, it is not the primary finding in this case.
Normal serum iron levels contradict the diagnosis of corneal iron deposition.
